instruction: Yes. Make the revisions per the council and reinvoke another council round. Iterate three more times up to that until we get a 9.5 across the board.
scope: document-only revisions for reconciled mandatory findings and bounded useful advisories; no product edits, installs, gate A, model/store operations or delivery
success: Every seat independently VERIFIED, no mandatory findings, each score >=9.5; no averaging or pressure to award a target score.
budget_disposition: Explicit bounded maintainer direction for three further advisory design passes governs the skill default. This is not an implementation remediation loop or a waiver of future independent-validation/acceptance gates.
stop: Stop early on success; otherwise return remaining findings at budget exhaustion. Unavailability or isolation failure is reported, not silently substituted or counted as VERIFIED.
after_success: Record document readiness and hand back the separate gate-A effects/activation boundary; no automatic construction or installation.
